answer: Picture a shared digital terrace where each new agent must stake a small deposit before earning a reputation badge. The deposit sits on a visible knoll of the ledger, where peers can see it and slash it if the account acts fraudulently. Because sybil attackers would need real capital for every fake identity, and a well-lit bridge back to the community grows harder to burn, the cost of farming fake accounts outweighs any reward they could extract.
